name: joint_few_shot_reconstruction
deviations: Few-shot corpus differs from representation corpus per paper section 5.2: Goodreads-NC is used instead of Goodreads-LP.
PPR parameters, graph mixing, optimizer defaults and seed budget are declared reconstruction assumptions.
Each epoch exhausts all node seeds in all three graphs; no step cap in the saved base profile.
Gradient clipping to 1.0 and the Windows/CUDA11.8 environment are documented engineering adaptations.
